Split Record Heatmap Viewer

Keys: Space play / pause, ← / → frame, Shift + ← / → jump 10 frames, [ / ] prev / next mark.

Marks

Obs Image

Current 2D observation decoded from obs range.

Obs 1D

Current 1D observation strip.

Encoded Obs

Full encoder output fed into SRU memory.

Encoded Image Tail

Tail slice of encoded_obs attributed to image features.

Latent

SRU output latent.

Actions

Final actor output.

Encoded Obs Context

Rows are time around the current frame. Center row is highlighted.

Latent Context

Temporal context for SRU latent.

Action Context

Temporal context for actor output.
